undeclared.reason: The CSRF check of src/start.ts refuses a POST, PATCH or DELETE from another origin before the API runs, with a plain-text body and no tagged error. It applies to every write alike, so the API description in src/contract/api.ts states it once instead of every operation declaring it.

An unexpected failure (a bug, or the database unreachable) is an empty 500 from ServerMiddleware in src/server/api/web-handler.ts. Every operation can answer it and none can do anything but fail, so the API description states it once; tests/api/database-down.test.ts and tests/integration/db-failure.test.ts provoke it on purpose.
